# Game Idea: Orbital Defense

A simple HTML‑canvas game where the player rotates a shield around a planet to block incoming asteroids. Each asteroid that hits the planet reduces its health. **Lose condition:** the planet’s health reaches zero.

<content>
1: // Simple Orbital Defense game
2: // Canvas element with id="game" must exist in the HTML.
3: 
4: (() => {
5:   // Audio setup
6:   const audioCtx = new (window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext)();
7:   function playFreq(freq, duration) {
8:     const osc = audioCtx.createOscillator();
9:     const gain = audioCtx.createGain();
10:     osc.type = 'sine';
11:     osc.frequency.value = freq;
12:     osc.connect(gain);
13:     gain.connect(audioCtx.destination);
14:     gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.2, audioCtx.currentTime);
15:     osc.start();
16:     osc.stop(audioCtx.currentTime + duration);
17:   }
18:   let gameOverSoundPlayed = false;
19:   const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
20:   if (!canvas) return; // no canvas, abort
21:   const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
22: 
23:   // Set canvas size to fill its container (optional: could be fixed)
24:   canvas.width = canvas.clientWidth || 800;
25:   canvas.height = canvas.clientHeight || 600;
26: 
27:   const center = { x: canvas.width / 2, y: canvas.height / 2 };
28: 
29:   // generate background stars
30:   (function initStars() {
31:     const starCount = 100;
32:     for (let i = 0; i < starCount; i++) {
33:       stars.push({
34:         x: Math.random() * canvas.width,
35:         y: Math.random() * canvas.height
36:       });
37:     }
38:   })();
39:   const planetRadius = 30;
40:   const shieldRadius = planetRadius + 20;
41:   const shieldWidthDeg = 40; // angular width of shield in degrees
42:   let shieldAngle = 0; // in radians, 0 points to the right
43: 
44:   let health = 5;
45:   let gameOver = false;
46: 
47:   const asteroids = [];
48:   const stars = [];
49:   const particles = [];
50:   const asteroidSpeed = 2;
51:   const spawnInterval = 1500; // ms
52: 
53:   // Controls – rotate shield with left/right arrows
54:   const rotateStep = Math.PI / 30; // 6 degrees per press
55:   const keys = {};
56:   window.addEventListener('keydown', e => { keys[e.key] = true; });
57:   window.addEventListener('keyup', e => { keys[e.key] = false; });
58:   // resume audio context on first user interaction
59:   window.addEventListener('click', () => { audioCtx.resume(); }, { once: true });
60: 
61:   function spawnAsteroid() {
62:     // random edge position
63:     const side = Math.floor(Math.random() * 4);
64:     let x, y, vx, vy;
65:     if (side === 0) { // top
66:       x = Math.random() * canvas.width;
67:       y = -10;
68:     } else if (side === 1) { // right
69:       x = canvas.width + 10;
70:       y = Math.random() * canvas.height;
71:     } else if (side === 2) { // bottom
72:       x = Math.random() * canvas.width;
73:       y = canvas.height + 10;
74:     } else { // left
75:       x = -10;
76:       y = Math.random() * canvas.height;
77:     }
78:     // direction vector toward planet center
79:     const dx = center.x - x;
80:     const dy = center.y - y;
81:     const len = Math.hypot(dx, dy);
82:     vx = (dx / len) * asteroidSpeed;
83:     vy = (dy / len) * asteroidSpeed;
84:     asteroids.push({ x, y, vx, vy, radius: 8 });
85:   }
86: 
87:   function update() {
88:     if (gameOver) return;
89:     // shield rotation controls
90:     if (keys['ArrowLeft']) shieldAngle -= rotateStep;
91:     if (keys['ArrowRight']) shieldAngle += rotateStep;
92:     // normalize angle
93:     shieldAngle = (shieldAngle + Math.PI * 2) % (Math.PI * 2);
94: 
95:     // move asteroids
96:     for (let i = asteroids.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
97:       const a = asteroids[i];
98:       a.x += a.vx;
99:       a.y += a.vy;
100: 
101:       // distance to planet center
102:       const dx = a.x - center.x;
103:       const dy = a.y - center.y;
104:       const dist = Math.hypot(dx, dy);
105: 
106:       // angle of asteroid relative to planet
107:       const angle = Math.atan2(dy, dx);
108:       const diff = Math.abs(((angle - shieldAngle + Math.PI) % (2 * Math.PI)) - Math.PI);
109: 
110:       const shieldHalf = (shieldWidthDeg * Math.PI / 180) / 2;
111: 
112: if (dist <= shieldRadius && diff <= shieldHalf) {
113:           // blocked by shield – remove asteroid and play sound
114:           asteroids.splice(i, 1);
115:           playFreq(400, 0.08);
116:           continue;
117:         }
118: 
119: if (dist <= planetRadius) {
120:           // hit planet – create explosion particles and sound
121:           health--;
122:           // play hit sound
123:           playFreq(200, 0.15);
124:           // generate particles
125:           for (let p = 0; p < 8; p++) {
126:             const angle = Math.random() * Math.PI * 2;
127:             const speed = Math.random() * 2 + 0.5;
128:             particles.push({
129:               x: a.x,
130:               y: a.y,
131:               vx: Math.cos(angle) * speed,
132:               vy: Math.sin(angle) * speed,
133:               radius: Math.random() * 2 + 1,
134:               alpha: 1
135:             });
136:           }
137:           asteroids.splice(i, 1);
138:           if (health <= 0) {
139:             gameOver = true;
140:             if (!gameOverSoundPlayed) {
141:               playFreq(100, 0.6);
142:               gameOverSoundPlayed = true;
143:             }
144:           }
145:         }
146:       }
147:     }
148:   }
149: 
150:   function draw() {
151:     // background stars
152:     ctx.fillStyle = '#000';
153:     ctx.fillRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
154:     ctx.fillStyle = '#555';
155:     stars.forEach(s => {
156:       ctx.fillRect(s.x, s.y, 2, 2);
157:     });
158: 
159:     // planet with gradient
160:     const planetGrad = ctx.createRadialGradient(
161:       center.x,
162:       center.y,
163:       planetRadius * 0.2,
164:       center.x,
165:       center.y,
166:       planetRadius
167:     );
168:     planetGrad.addColorStop(0, '#4caf50');
169:     planetGrad.addColorStop(1, '#1b5e20');
170:     ctx.fillStyle = planetGrad;
171:     ctx.beginPath();
172:     ctx.arc(center.x, center.y, planetRadius, 0, Math.PI * 2);
173:     ctx.fill();
174: 
175:     // shield with glow
176:     ctx.save();
177:     ctx.strokeStyle = '#ffeb3b';
178:     ctx.lineWidth = 12;
179:     ctx.shadowBlur = 15;
180:     ctx.shadowColor = '#ffeb3b';
181:     const start = shieldAngle - (shieldWidthDeg * Math.PI / 180) / 2;
182:     const end = shieldAngle + (shieldWidthDeg * Math.PI / 180) / 2;
183:     ctx.beginPath();
184:     ctx.arc(center.x, center.y, shieldRadius, start, end);
185:     ctx.stroke();
186:     ctx.restore();
187: 
188:     // asteroids with gradient
189:     asteroids.forEach(a => {
190:       const grad = ctx.createRadialGradient(a.x, a.y, a.radius * 0.2, a.x, a.y, a.radius);
191:       grad.addColorStop(0, '#ff8a80');
192:       grad.addColorStop(1, '#c62828');
193:       ctx.fillStyle = grad;
194:       ctx.beginPath();
195:       ctx.arc(a.x, a.y, a.radius, 0, Math.PI * 2);
196:       ctx.fill();
197:     });
198: 
199:     // particles (explosions)
200:     particles.forEach((p, i) => {
201:       ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(255,165,0,${p.alpha})`;
202:       ctx.beginPath();
203:       ctx.arc(p.x, p.y, p.radius, 0, Math.PI * 2);
204:       ctx.fill();
205:       p.x += p.vx; p.y += p.vy; p.alpha -= 0.02;
206:       if (p.alpha <= 0) particles.splice(i, 1);
207:     });
208: 
209:     // health UI
210:     ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
211:     ctx.font = '20px sans-serif';
212:     ctx.fillText(`Health: ${health}`, 10, 30);
213: 
214:     if (gameOver) {
215:       ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.6)';
216:       ctx.fillRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
217:       ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
218:       ctx.textAlign = 'center';
219:       ctx.font = '48px sans-serif';
220:       ctx.fillText('Game Over', canvas.width / 2, canvas.height / 2);
221:     }
222:   }
223: 
224:   function loop() {
225:     update();
226:     draw();
227:     if (!gameOver) requestAnimationFrame(loop);
228:   }
229: 
230:   // start
231:   setInterval(spawnAsteroid, spawnInterval);
232:   requestAnimationFrame(loop);
233: })();

(End of file - total 233 lines)
</content>
